{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:54:25+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Hey, want to see the Job Board?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:20+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Oh, I'm glad you're looking into the life under the ice!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:38+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We've got people taking bets on how the critters are surviving..."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:40+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "And a colleague down south in Antarctica who thinks we're making the whole thing up."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:43+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Whoa... how many people know about this??"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:45+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "We're a tight-knit community, Ollie. People talk."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:49+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "So how can I figure out what's keeping these creatures alive?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:53+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "You'll need to observe the relationships between the species you discovered at site X."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-stationary-survival.start", "server_time": "2026-08-03T01:55:55+00:00", "speaker": "", "text_string": "Then create a Visual Model and see what it reveals."}
